name: WF-411 — Comps, ARV & Repair Estimate Analysis Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,address:String(b.address??b.propertyAddress??'').trim(),receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Comps Analysis Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const p=ctx.property??input.property??{}; const comps=Array.isArray(ctx.comps)?ctx.comps:[]; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const subjectSqft=num(p.sqft??p.squareFeet); const subjectBeds=num(p.beds??p.bedrooms); const subjectBaths=num(p.baths??p.bathrooms); const subjectYear=num(p.yearBuilt); const subjectValue=num(p.currentValue??p.estimatedValue??p.arv); const valid=comps.map(c=>({...c,salePrice:num(c.salePrice??c.price),sqft:num(c.sqft??c.squareFeet),beds:num(c.beds??c.bedrooms),baths:num(c.baths??c.bathrooms),yearBuilt:num(c.yearBuilt),distanceMiles:num(c.distanceMiles??c.distance)})).filter(c=>c.salePrice!==null&&c.salePrice>0); const weighted=[]; for(const c of valid){let score=1; if(subjectSqft&&c.sqft)score*=Math.max(.2,1-Math.min(.5,Math.abs(c.sqft-subjectSqft)/subjectSqft)); if(subjectBeds!==null&&c.beds!==null)score*=Math.max(.4,1-Math.min(.3,Math.abs(c.beds-subjectBeds)*.15)); if(subjectBaths!==null&&c.baths!==null)score*=Math.max(.5,1-Math.min(.25,Math.abs(c.baths-subjectBaths)*.12)); if(subjectYear&&c.yearBuilt)score*=Math.max(.5,1-Math.min(.2,Math.abs(c.yearBuilt-subjectYear)/50)); if(c.distanceMiles!==null)score*=Math.max(.25,1-Math.min(.5,c.distanceMiles/10)); weighted.push({...c,weight:score,pricePerSqft:c.sqft?c.salePrice/c.sqft:null}); } const wsum=weighted.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.weight,0); const weightedValue=wsum?weighted.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.salePrice*c.weight,0)/wsum:null; const ppsf=weighted.filter(c=>c.pricePerSqft!==null); const median=(a)=>{if(!a.length)return null;const x=[...a].sort((a,b)=>a-b);const m=Math.floor(x.length/2);return x.length%2?x[m]:(x[m-1]+x[m])/2}; const medianPpsf=median(ppsf.map(c=>c.pricePerSqft)); const sqftArv=subjectSqft&&medianPpsf?subjectSqft*medianPpsf:null; const arvCandidates=[weightedValue,sqftArv,subjectValue].filter(v=>v!==null&&v>0); const arv=arvCandidates.length?arvCandidates.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/arvCandidates.length:null; const repairInputs=Array.isArray(ctx.repairEstimates)?ctx.repairEstimates:[]; const repairTotal=repairInputs.map(r=>num(r.amount??r.cost)).filter(v=>v!==null&&v>=0).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); const providedRepair=num(p.repairs??ctx.repairs); const repairs=repairInputs.length?repairTotal:providedRepair; const confidence=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(valid.length>=3?45:valid.length*15)+(weightedValue!==null?20:0)+(medianPpsf!==null?15:0)+(repairs!==null?10:0)+(subjectSqft?10:0))); const flags=[]; if(valid.length<3)flags.push('limited_comps'); if(valid.length===0)flags.push('no_valid_comps'); if(arv===null)flags.push('arv_unavailable'); if(repairs===null)flags.push('repair_estimate_unavailable'); if(repairs!==null&&arv&&repairs/arv>=.2)flags.push('high_repair_burden'); const status=arv!==null&&repairs!==null&&valid.length>=3?'analysis_ready':arv!==null?'partial_analysis':'insufficient_data'; const idempotencyKey='wf411:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId; return [{json:{...input,analysis:{status,arv,repairEstimate:repairs,compCount:valid.length,weightedCompValue:weightedValue,medianPricePerSqft:medianPpsf,confidenceScore:Math.round(confidence),flags,comparables:weighted.map(c=>({id:c.id??null,address:c.address??null,salePrice:c.salePrice,sqft:c.sqft,pricePerSqft:c.pricePerSqft,weight:Number(c.weight.toFixed(4))}))},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Comparable selection, ARV and repair calculations are deterministic scaffolding pending production comp provider, repair estimation provider, verified InsulaCRM field mappings, and final API contracts.
